scenarios.name: a worker-only update is never installed ahead of its adoption record: the unadopted new worker is rejected and the adopted shell keeps serving offline

limits: A damaged index.html or adoption/manifest record leaves the offline shell unable to repair itself from the page; recovery is clearing site data (exercised with Storage.clearDataForOrigin) and preparing again.

Worker update rollback is not atomic: a new worker is only admitted while the adoption record names it, but if it finished activating before a rollback write, it stays active against the restored record and fails closed (network online, explicit 503 offline) until the user prepares again. The harness exercises the rejected-install and successful A-to-B paths, not that race.
